commands.customName: composer install (retrying, then falling back to git source)
commands.cmd: i=0; ok=0; while [ $i -lt 4 ]; do i=$((i+1)); if composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts --no-interaction; then ok=1; break; fi; echo "composer install attempt $i failed; retrying in $((i*5))s"; sleep $((i*5)); done; if [ $ok -eq 0 ]; then echo 'dist downloads kept failing; retrying from git source, which bypasses codeload zipballs'; composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts --no-interaction --prefer-source; fi
